content: Run Rabbit Run Americas Financial Collapse . BOOK .  America is recovering from a financial  ressesion  when the worst happens and the  encomoy  collapses, businesses close and the dollar plummets as a virus takes out the country, with too many sick to work, things began shutting down and soon, there is almost nothing left Martin and Elle watch in horror as everything they have worked for is not worthless, In a last ditch attempt to wait out the worst, they escape to Martin’s parents cabin deep in the mountains and try and survive off of the land , neither one of them ever having to do it before it becomes a battle of will vs mother nature.  Martin and Elle James Engineer and a Vet Martin and Elle were a typical small town couple, both working and both happy as they lived with  there  two pit bulls  ezra  and  escobar  until the country began to collapse, at first it was small but then everything slid , the dollar devalued they soon find themselves In the middle of a total infrastructure collapse .
